description: Source code for a TinySRP client implementation, including functions for client creation, key generation, password processing, key retrieval, verification, and cleanup, utilizing cryptographic operations and big integer arithmetic.

methods.name: t_clientopen
methods.description: Initializes a new SRP client session with user credentials and parameters, performing validation and cryptographic hashing.

methods.name: t_clientgenexp
methods.description: Generates a public ephemeral value (A) for the SRP protocol based on a random private exponent.

methods.name: t_clientpasswd
methods.description: Computes verifier and related parameters from the password, user, and salt.

methods.name: t_clientgetkey
methods.description: Calculates the session key based on server's public value and client parameters, performing SRP computations.

methods.name: t_clientverify
methods.description: Verifies server response against expected session proof.

methods.name: t_clientclose
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with the client session.
